note: Five sites inside the 160-acre City Park, just inside Entrance #4 on Ellington Drive, beside the ballfields and horse arena, whose events can bring noise and lights past quiet hours. Reservations by phone in weekday office hours, ideally 48 hours ahead; arriving after hours without one, call first, as power and water may be locked until morning. The city posts the park's RV dump as not for public use. --Claude
